description:
## Question

Which names change before 0.1.0? After 0.1.0 the stability promise (CONTEXT.md) freezes them, and a rename needs a deprecation.

In scope (decided on the map 'Wayfinder: defk ready for a first Hex release'): the public tier of ADR-0006 (modules, functions, macros), the defk options (for example yield:, max_owned), the builtins of the kernel subset (for example alloc/2, crc32c/3), and the error codes (docs/compile-errors.md; their 'never renamed' rule starts at the release). Out of scope: the package name defk.

Done when: each name has a keep or rename decision, the renames are recorded as a list, and the work they cause is ticketed under the map.

comments.text:
Resolution (grilling, 2026-10-14). Rules: a name changes when it misleads, breaks a pattern of similar names, or is unclear or far from Elixir's own names (Q1 b). In scope: the public tier, the options, the builtins, the error codes, and the kernel subset's type names; unstable and hidden tiers out (Q2). Renames happen in place before 0.1.0, no deprecated aliases; CHANGELOG.md names old and new (Q3).

Renames (the list):
1. builtins rotl64/2, rotr64/2 -> rotl/2, rotr/2 (same pattern as clz/1, clz/2); Defk.Bits too.
2. builtin f64_to_u64/1 -> f64_bits/1 (it is a bit cast, not a conversion); Defk.Bits too.
3. builtin len/1 -> length/1 (Elixir's name; docs say it is constant time).
4. use Defk option max_owned: -> max_owned_bytes: (the unit in the name).
5. Defk.Errors.codes/0 -> Defk.Errors.entries/0 (it returns entries, not codes).
6. error code unknown-function -> undefined-function (Elixir's term; pairs with undefined-variable, undefined-attribute).
7. error code u64-mix -> u64-with-i64.

Kept: every other name in scope: modules Defk, Defk.Test, Defk.ElixirMode, Defk.Bits, Defk.Report, Defk.Errors; use Defk, defk, assert_agrees/4, agreement_reason/1, with_mode/2, Report.print/1, Report.format/1, explain!/1; __defk_elixir__/2, __defk_force_yields__/1; elixir_mode:, report: :full, yield: false, config :defk, mode: (Q9), CC, ERTS_INCLUDE_DIR; copy/5 and copy_back/4 (Q7); the other 71 error codes (the unsupported-* prefix stays partial, Q11); the other builtins incl. mulhi, clz, ctz, popcount, wrap64, crc32c, the loads; the types i64 u64 f64 f32 i32 i16 u8 bool [T] bitstring.

Work: ticketed under the map as one task.

title: Rename review: the public tier, the options, the builtins, the error codes
